question: Anupama Bhagwat is associated with which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sitar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Anupama Bhagwat** is a renowned Indian classical musician.
 
• She is associated with the **Sitar**, which is a plucked stringed instrument used mainly in Indian classical music.
 
• Anupama Bhagwat has performed extensively both in India and internationally, earning acclaim for her skill and artistry on the Sitar.
